description.en: Retail / Shop in Islas del Rosario, Colombia. The asset occupies 19,079 m². The asset is ready to occupy. Title is held freehold under Colombia law. Provision includes outdoor space and leisure amenities. The listing has been verified by the XARU HOME desk and its documentation reviewed. This record is platform demonstration inventory: the structure, the workflow and the data model are the production ones, the asset is not.
